verdict.rationale: Jira documents a broad first-party REST API: an OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec with 433 paths, versioned v2/v3, and a formal deprecation policy. Community users confirm scripting issue creation and running JQL queries over REST. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that every UI action is available through the API, so parity is plausible but unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity claim, coverage evidence for board, timeline, form and automation configuration via the API, and independent hands-on confirmation of full parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Atlassian publishes the Jira Cloud platform REST API as a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.1 document (info title "The Jira Cloud platform REST API", 433 paths)
